<action type="say">
Yes, I can help you plan the logistics end-to-end. I’ll need a few details first:

1) Location & date(s)
- Which zoo and city are you planning to visit?
- Do you already have a specific date in mind, or a date range (e.g., “any weekday the week of Oct 7–11”)?
- What time window are you aiming for on that day (e.g., 9am–2pm)?

2) Class details
- How many students, and what grade/age?
- How many adults/chaperones will you have (or school’s required ratio)?

3) Transport & departure
- How will you travel (school buses, public transit, walking, parent cars)?
- From which school/location will you depart, and what time do you need to be back?

4) Constraints & preferences
- Any budget constraints?
- Any accessibility or medical needs to account for?
- Anything special you want to include (guided tour, animal show, lunch at the zoo, worksheet activity, etc.)?

Once I have these, I’ll check weather for your target date(s), suggest ideal timing, and lay out a clear schedule and logistics checklist you can use to finalize bookings and permissions.</action>
